fixtures.purpose: 恢复审计日志配置的用例前状态

确认 fdb.audit_log_directory 已生效

steps.title: SAO 修改审计日志文件前缀
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET fdb.audit_log_prefix = 'fbase_regress_audit'

steps.title: 重载 fdb.audit_log_prefix 配置
确认 fdb.audit_log_prefix 已生效
steps.sql: SHOW fdb.audit_log_prefix

steps.title: SAO 将审计日志改为明文存储
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET fdb.audit_log_encrypt = 'plain'

steps.title: 重载 fdb.audit_log_encrypt 配置
确认 fdb.audit_log_encrypt 已生效
steps.sql: SHOW fdb.audit_log_encrypt

steps.title: SAO 将审计日志改为 RC4 存储

steps.title: 重载 fdb.audit_log_encrypt 配置

steps.sql: SHOW fdb.audit_log_encrypt

steps.title: SAO 修改审计日志加密密钥
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET fdb.audit_log_key = 'fbaseRegressKey'

steps.title: 重载 fdb.audit_log_key 配置
确认 fdb.audit_log_key 已生效
steps.sql: SHOW fdb.audit_log_key

steps.title: SAO 设置审计日志查询时间窗为 1 天

steps.title: 重载 fdb.audit_log_query_interval 配置
确认 fdb.audit_log_query_interval 已生效
steps.sql: SHOW fdb.audit_log_query_interval

cases.final_state: 确认 fdb.audit_log_query_interval 已生效：返回 1

cases.name: 创建和修改用户的 ROLE 审计日志
cases.document: 审计功能转测（邹雪、陈群友）.md

fixtures.purpose: 启用 ROLE 审计规则所需的审计开关
恢复三权分立开关的用例前状态

prerequisites: SAO 可以设置 ROLE 审计规则，DBA 可执行角色管理命令

steps.title: SSO 关闭三权分立以执行文档中的带密码 CREATE ROLE
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET fdb.separate_user = off

steps.title: 重载三权分立配置
SAO 设置审计 postgres 的 ROLE 规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_audit_role_rule', 'ROLE', 'postgres', 'ALL')

steps.title: DBA 创建带密码的角色 U1
steps.sql: CREATE ROLE fbase_regress_audit_role_u1_2a2632dfca50 WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'Aa123456'

steps.title: DBA 重复创建 U1 失败
steps.sql: CREATE ROLE fbase_regress_audit_role_u1_2a2632dfca50 WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'Aa123456'

steps.title: DBA 创建带有效期的角色 U2
steps.sql: CREATE ROLE fbase_regress_audit_role_u2_2a2632dfca50 WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'Aa123456' VALID UNTIL '2099-01-01'

steps.title: DBA 重复创建 U2 失败
steps.sql: CREATE ROLE fbase_regress_audit_role_u2_2a2632dfca50 WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'Aa123456' VALID UNTIL '2099-01-01'

steps.title: DBA 修改 U1 的密码和有效期
steps.sql: ALTER ROLE fbase_regress_audit_role_u1_2a2632dfca50 PASSWORD 'Bb123456' VALID UNTIL '2099-01-01'

steps.title: DBA 修改不存在角色失败
steps.sql: ALTER ROLE fbase_regress_audit_role_missing_2a2632dfca50 PASSWORD 'Bb123456' VALID UNTIL '2099-01-01'

steps.title: SAO 查到 ROLE 审计的成功和失败记录
steps.sql: SELECT succ, count(*)::text FROM fdb_audit.audit_records WHERE audittype = 'ROLE' AND username = 'postgres' AND objname IN ('fbase_regress_audit_role_u1_2a2632dfca50', 'fbase_regress_audit_role_u2_2a2632dfca50', 'fbase_regress_audit_role_missing_2a2632dfca50') GROUP BY succ ORDER BY succ

cases.teardown: audit_rules fixture 删除 ROLE 规则；roles fixture 删除 U1、U2；两个 settings fixture 恢复审计和三权分立配置。
cases.purpose: 验证创建和修改用户的 ROLE 审计日志。重点核对：DBA 重复创建 U2 失败；DBA 修改不存在角色失败；SAO 查到 ROLE 审计的成功和失败记录。
cases.final_state: SAO 查到 ROLE 审计的成功和失败记录：返回 FAILED=3、SUCCESS=3

cases.name: 审计规则取消权限与规则类型校验
cases.document: 审计功能转测（邹雪、陈群友）.md

fixtures.purpose: 启用审计规则取消所需的审计开关

prerequisites: 审计功能已开启，审计规则 UDF 和元数据表存在

steps.title: SSO 创建自身语句级审计规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_cancel_sso_stmt', 'SELECT', 'sao', 'FAIL')

steps.title: SAO 创建自身语句级审计规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_cancel_sao_stmt', 'SELECT', 'sso', 'SUCCESS')

steps.title: SAO 创建自身对象级审计规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_object('fbase_regress_cancel_sao_object', 'SELECT', 'sso', 'SUCCESS', 'TABLE', 'public', 'fbase_regress_audit_cancel_object')

steps.title: 确认三条审计规则创建事实
steps.sql: SELECT rule_name, rule_type, audit_user, audit_type, user_name, audit_when, obj_type, obj_schema, obj_name FROM fdb_audit.audit_rule WHERE rule_name IN ('fbase_regress_cancel_sso_stmt', 'fbase_regress_cancel_sao_stmt', 'fbase_regress_cancel_sao_object') ORDER BY rule_name
steps.expected: 精确返回 SSO 语句规则、SAO 对象规则和 SAO 语句规则的 owner、类型、审计对象与时机

steps.title: SAO 不能取消 SSO 创建的规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.cancel_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_cancel_sso_stmt')
steps.expected: 执行失败，只能取消自身设置的规则

steps.title: SSO 不能取消 SAO 创建的规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.cancel_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_cancel_sao_stmt')
steps.expected: 执行失败，只能取消自身设置的规则

steps.title: SAO 不能用语句级取消函数取消对象级规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.cancel_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_cancel_sao_object')
steps.expected: 执行失败，对象级规则必须使用 cancel_audit_object

steps.title: SAO 不能用对象级取消函数取消语句级规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.cancel_audit_object('fbase_regress_cancel_sao_stmt')
steps.expected: 执行失败，语句级规则必须使用 cancel_audit_stmt

steps.title: SAO 正确取消自身对象级规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.cancel_audit_object('fbase_regress_cancel_sao_object')

steps.title: SAO 正确取消自身语句级规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.cancel_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_cancel_sao_stmt')

steps.title: SSO 正确取消自身语句级规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.cancel_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_cancel_sso_stmt')

steps.title: 确认三条测试规则均已删除
steps.sql: SELECT count(*)::text FROM fdb_audit.audit_rule WHERE rule_name IN ('fbase_regress_cancel_sso_stmt', 'fbase_regress_cancel_sao_stmt', 'fbase_regress_cancel_sao_object')

cases.teardown: audit_rules fixture 清理任何中途遗留的规则；table fixture 删除对象级规则使用的测试表；settings fixture 恢复审计开关。
cases.purpose: 验证审计规则取消权限与规则类型校验。重点核对：SAO 不能用语句级取消函数取消对象级规则；SAO 不能用对象级取消函数取消语句级规则；三条测试规则均已删除。
cases.final_state: 确认三条测试规则均已删除：查询结果为 0

fixtures.purpose: 启用审计规则设置所需的审计开关

prerequisites: 审计功能已开启，fdb_audit 审计规则 UDF 和元数据表存在
普通测试用户和对象级审计所需测试表可用

steps.title: 超级用户不能设置对象级审计规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_object('fbase_regress_denied_postgres', 'SELECT', 'sao', 'ALL', 'TABLE', 'public', 'fbase_regress_audit_object')
steps.expected: 执行失败，仅 SAO/SSO 可以设置审计规则

assertion.message_contains: must be SAO/SSO user can execute this function

steps.title: 普通用户不能设置对象级审计规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_object('fbase_regress_denied_user', 'SELECT', 'sao', 'ALL', 'TABLE', 'public', 'fbase_regress_audit_object')
steps.expected: 执行失败，普通用户无 fdb_audit schema 使用权限，因而不能设置审计规则

steps.title: SSO 不能审计普通用户
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_sso_denied_user', 'SELECT', 'fbase_regress_audit_user', 'FAIL')

steps.title: SSO 不能审计自身
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_object('fbase_regress_sso_denied_self', 'SELECT', 'sso', 'FAIL', 'TABLE', 'public', 'fbase_regress_audit_object')
steps.expected: 执行失败，不能设置审计自身的规则

assertion.message_contains: can not set audit rules for self

steps.title: SSO 设置审计 SAO 的语句级规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_sso_stmt', 'SELECT', 'sao', 'FAIL')

steps.title: SSO 设置审计 SAO 的对象级规则
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_object('fbase_regress_sso_object', 'SELECT', 'sao', 'SUCCESS', 'TABLE', 'public', 'fbase_regress_audit_object')

steps.title: SSO 不能直接查看审计规则元数据表
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM fdb_audit.audit_rule

steps.sql: SELECT rule_name, rule_type, audit_user, audit_type, user_name, audit_when, obj_type, obj_schema, obj_name FROM fdb_audit.audit_rules WHERE rule_name LIKE 'fbase_regress_sso_%' ORDER BY rule_name
steps.expected: 返回 SSO 创建的一条对象级和一条语句级规则

steps.title: SAO 不能审计自身
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_sao_denied_self', 'SELECT', 'sao', 'SUCCESS')
steps.expected: 执行失败，不能设置审计自身的规则

assertion.message_contains: can not set audit rules for self

steps.title: SAO 可审计超级用户
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_sao_postgres', 'SELECT', 'postgres', 'SUCCESS')

steps.title: SAO 可审计 SSO
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_sao_sso', 'SELECT', 'sso', 'SUCCESS')

steps.title: SAO 可审计普通用户
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_audit.set_audit_stmt('fbase_regress_sao_user', 'UPDATE', 'fbase_regress_audit_user', 'SUCCESS')

steps.title: SAO 可查看 SSO 和 SAO 创建的全部规则
steps.sql: SELECT rule_name, audit_user, audit_type, user_name, audit_when FROM fdb_audit.audit_rule WHERE rule_name LIKE 'fbase_regress_sso_%' OR rule_name LIKE 'fbase_regress_sao_%' ORDER BY rule_name
steps.expected: 返回两条 SSO 规则和三条 SAO 规则

cases.teardown: audit_rules fixture 按规则所有者删除创建的规则；table 和普通用户 fixture 删除测试对象；settings fixture 恢复审计开关。
cases.purpose: 验证审计规则设置权限与可见性。重点核对：SSO 可从审计规则视图查看自身规则；SAO 不能审计自身；SAO 可查看 SSO 和 SAO 创建的全部规则。
cases.final_state: SAO 可查看 SSO 和 SAO 创建的全部规则：返回两条 SSO 规则和三条 SAO 规则

prerequisites: 主备流复制健康；用例仅建立专属发布、订阅、表和 failover 槽，不使用环境的全表发布订阅

steps.sql: SELECT count(*)::text FROM public.fbase_regress_failover_delay

steps.sql: CREATE FUNCTION udf_to_tsvector(regconfig, text) RETURNS tsvector AS $$ SELECT array_to_tsvector(array_agg(token)) FROM ts_debug($1, $2) WHERE (char_length(token) = 1 AND octet_length(token) <> 1) OR (char_length(token) = octet_length(token)) $$ LANGUAGE sql STRICT IMMUTABLE

steps.title: 插入含方言的中文文本
steps.sql: INSERT INTO fbase_regress_gb18030_fts_table(info) VALUES ('中文（汉语）有标准语和方言之分，其标准语即汉语普通话，是规范后的汉民族共同语，也是中国的国家通用语言。现代汉语方言一般可分为：官话方言、吴方言、湘方言、客家方言、闽方言、粤方言、赣方言等')

steps.title: 插入历史中文文本
steps.sql: INSERT INTO fbase_regress_gb18030_fts_table(info) VALUES ('相传黄帝时中原有万国，夏朝时还有三千国，周初分封八百诸侯，而五方之民，言语不通')

steps.title: 插入英文文本
steps.sql: INSERT INTO fbase_regress_gb18030_fts_table(info) VALUES ('Time goes by so fast, people go in and out of your life')

steps.title: 创建 zhparser GIN 全文索引
steps.sql: CREATE INDEX fbase_regress_gb18030_fts_table_idx ON fbase_regress_gb18030_fts_table USING gin(to_tsvector('zh', info))

steps.title: AND 组合检索中文和方言
steps.sql: SELECT id::text FROM fbase_regress_gb18030_fts_table WHERE to_tsvector('zh', info) @@ to_tsquery('中文') AND to_tsvector('zh', info) @@ to_tsquery('方言')
steps.expected: 仅返回第二段文本的 ID 2

steps.title: OR 组合检索中文和英文 people
steps.sql: SELECT id::text FROM fbase_regress_gb18030_fts_table WHERE to_tsvector('zh', info) @@ to_tsquery('中文') OR udf_to_tsvector('zh', info) @@ to_tsquery('simple', 'people') ORDER BY id

steps.title: AND NOT 排除普通话文本
steps.sql: SELECT id::text FROM fbase_regress_gb18030_fts_table WHERE to_tsvector('zh', info) @@ to_tsquery('中文') AND NOT to_tsvector('zh', info) @@ to_tsquery('普通话')
steps.expected: 仅返回第一段文本的 ID 1

steps.title: 配置预加载、密码周期和专用密码认证
argv:
cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_password_expiry_{run_id}/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fbase_mac'
password_encryption = 'sm3'
fdb.password_change_interval = 15
fdb.password_rule = 0

listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'

logging_collector = on

" >> {env.tmp_root}_password_expiry_{run_id}/postgresql.conf; printf "local all all trust
host all postgres {env.local_host}/32 trust
host all all {env.local_host}/32 password

steps.title: 超级用户生成 TLCP CA 和服务端双证书
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_mac.generate_ca_certificate('tlcp','/C=AA/ST=BB/O=Fbase/OU=Regress/CN=fbase-regress-ca',2,'!Aa242260'); SELECT fdb_mac.generate_server_certificate('tlcp','/C=AA/ST=BB/O=Fbase/OU=Regress/CN=fbase-regress-server-sign','/C=AA/ST=BB/O=Fbase/OU=Regress/CN=fbase-regress-server-enc',2,'!Aa242260','!Aa123456','!Aa111111')

steps.title: 续期服务端证书
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_mac.renewal_certificate((SELECT max(id) FROM fdb_mac.certs_info WHERE useage='server'),7,'!Aa242260','!Aa111111'); SELECT count(*)::text, bool_and(end_time>start_time)::text FROM fdb_mac.certs_info WHERE useage='server'

steps.title: SSO 备份证书和私钥元数据
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_mac.backup_certificate(); SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fdb_mac.certs_info_bak)::text, (SELECT count(*) FROM fdb_mac.key_meta_data_bak)::text

steps.title: SSO 撤销服务端配对证书
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_mac.abort_certificate((SELECT max(id) FROM fdb_mac.certs_info WHERE useage='server'),7,'!Aa242260'); SELECT count(*)::text, bool_and(status='revoked')::text FROM fdb_mac.certs_info WHERE useage='server'

steps.title: SSO 归档已撤销服务端证书
steps.sql: SELECT fdb_mac.archive_certificate(); SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM fdb_mac.certs_info WHERE useage='server') = 0)::text, ((SELECT count(*) FROM fdb_mac.certs_info_achive WHERE useage='server' AND status='revoked') >= 2)::text

cases.name: 冲突记录配置的本地、远端和全节点控制
prerequisites: 隔离 A/node134、B/node135 采用 all 模式组成两节点组；四张表分别用于默认记录、类型过滤、处理结果过滤和远端节点配置。
日志由临时实例 pg_ctl 的 start.log 接收；验证时通过 pg_read_file 以 psql 形式读取该本轮日志。

steps.title: 初始化 A/node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_log_config_{run_id}/a; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_log_config_{run_id}/a -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_log_config_{run_id}/a/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15519
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_log_config_{run_id}/a/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_log_config_{run_id}/a -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_log_config_{run_id}/a/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_log_config_{run_id}/a/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15519 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15519 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15493
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15493 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15493 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

argv: delete_log='{env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_recent_delete_{run_id}/delete_transaction.log'; rm -f "$delete_log"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15497 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'BEGIN; DELETE FROM public.recent_delete_{run_id} WHERE id=1; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(2026072001); SELECT pg_sleep(4); COMMIT' >"$delete_log" 2>&1 & delete_pid=$!; ready=; for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do if ! kill -0 "$delete_pid" 2>/dev/null; then cat "$delete_log"; wait "$delete_pid"; exit 1; fi; ready=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15497 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(2026072001)' 2>/dev/null || true); test "$ready" = f && break; sleep 0.1; done; test "$ready" = f || { echo 'node135 DELETE transaction was not ready'; kill "$delete_pid"; wait "$delete_pid" || true; exit 1; }; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15496 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'UPDATE public.recent_delete_{run_id} SET id=3 WHERE id=1'; sleep 1; wait "$delete_pid"; cat "$delete_log"; rm -f "$delete_log"

steps.title: 初始化 A/node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_identity_full_pk_{run_id}/a; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_identity_full_pk_{run_id}/a -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_identity_full_pk_{run_id}/a/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15515
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_identity_full_pk_{run_id}/a/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_identity_full_pk_{run_id}/a -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_identity_full_pk_{run_id}/a/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_identity_full_pk_{run_id}/a/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15515 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15515 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

cases.name: 主键复制标识的 UPDATE-UPDATE 冲突
prerequisites: 隔离 A/node134、B/node135 采用 all 模式组成两节点组；三张表隔离同主键、不同主键及非主键更新场景。
两个节点使用相同系统时区；所有并发事务以 pg_sleep 固定文档列出的提交先后。

steps.title: 初始化 A/node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_pk_{run_id}/a; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_pk_{run_id}/a -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_pk_{run_id}/a/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15509
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_pk_{run_id}/a/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_pk_{run_id}/a -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_pk_{run_id}/a/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_pk_{run_id}/a/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15509 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15509 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

prerequisites: 文档标题误写为 4.3.1.2；本用例按覆盖清单对应 4.3.2.2。五张临时表分别隔离无主键三种场景和有主键两种场景。

steps.title: 初始化 A/node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_unique_{run_id}/a; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_unique_{run_id}/a -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_unique_{run_id}/a/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15511
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_unique_{run_id}/a/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_unique_{run_id}/a -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_unique_{run_id}/a/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_update_update_unique_{run_id}/a/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15511 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15511 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 无主键场景一并发修改 id/city，A 后提交
argv: first_log={env.tmp_root}_conflict_first.log; second_log={env.tmp_root}_conflict_second.log; rm -f "$first_log" "$second_log"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15511 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; UPDATE public.unique_nopk_one_{run_id} SET id=2,city='A' WHERE id=1; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(390000001); SELECT pg_sleep(2); COMMIT" >"$first_log" 2>&1 & first_pid=$!; first_ready=; for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do first_ready=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15511 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(390000001)' 2>/dev/null || true); test "$first_ready" = f && break; sleep 0.1; done; test "$first_ready" = f || { cat "$first_log"; exit 1; }; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15512 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; UPDATE public.unique_nopk_one_{run_id} SET id=2,city='B' WHERE id=1; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(390000002); SELECT pg_sleep(1); COMMIT" >"$second_log" 2>&1 & second_pid=$!; second_ready=; for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do second_ready=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15512 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(390000002)' 2>/dev/null || true); test "$second_ready" = f && break; sleep 0.1; done; test "$second_ready" = f || { cat "$first_log" "$second_log"; exit 1; }; first_status=0; second_status=0; wait "$first_pid" || first_status=$?; wait "$second_pid" || second_status=$?; cat "$first_log" "$second_log"; rm -f "$first_log" "$second_log"; test "$first_status" = 0 -a "$second_status" = 0
steps.expected: A/B 均 UPDATE 1，B 先 COMMIT、A 后 COMMIT
steps.display_sql:
-- A/node134
BEGIN; UPDATE public.unique_nopk_one_{run_id} SET id=2,city='A' WHERE id=1; SELECT pg_sleep(2); COMMIT;
-- B/node135
BEGIN; UPDATE public.unique_nopk_one_{run_id} SET id=2,city='B' WHERE id=1; SELECT pg_sleep(1); COMMIT

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_schema_filter_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_schema_filter_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_schema_filter_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_schema_filter_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_schema_filter_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_schema_filter_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_schema_filter_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

prerequisites: 在临时目录建立 node134 主库、其物理备库和 node135 多活节点；node134/node135 均使用 failover=true。

steps.title: 初始化 node134 旧主库
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_physical_failover_{run_id}/primary; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_physical_failover_{run_id}/primary -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_physical_failover_{run_id}/primary/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15521
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_physical_failover_{run_id}/primary/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_physical_failover_{run_id}/primary -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_physical_failover_{run_id}/primary/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_physical_failover_{run_id}/primary/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15521 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15521 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

cases.name: 全局序列强制分离节点与新节点加入
prerequisites: 三个临时实例使用 loopback DSN；seed 和 parted 先组成两节点集群。

steps.title: 初始化全局序列建组节点 node101
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_gseq_join_{run_id}/seed; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_gseq_join_{run_id}/seed -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_gseq_join_{run_id}/seed/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 7541
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_gseq_join_{run_id}/seed/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_gseq_join_{run_id}/seed -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_gseq_join_{run_id}/seed/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_gseq_join_{run_id}/seed/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 7541 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 7541 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

steps.title: 将 node101 的分离追增超时设为 60 秒

cases.section: 2.2 测试一,2.2 测试二,2.2 测试三
prerequisites: 两个临时实例均没有本地节点和组；分别用于普通组名和超过 63 字符组名的首次创建。
实例使用 loopback DSN，仅隔离验证文档 UDF 及元数据，不影响已有多活集群。

steps.title: 初始化普通组名隔离实例
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_group_creation_{run_id}/default; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_group_creation_{run_id}/default -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_group_creation_{run_id}/default/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15452
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_group_creation_{run_id}/default/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_group_creation_{run_id}/default -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_group_creation_{run_id}/default/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_group_creation_{run_id}/default/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15452 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15452 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

nodes.name: node137
nodes.role: 物理备库 -> 双数据库 MMR primary

relations: MMR 多活: postgres: node34,node35,node37；test: test34,test35,test37

prerequisites: 三个临时实例均在启动时配置 fdd.running_databases='postgres,test'；node135 在 node137 自动 join 期间不写入。

steps.title: 初始化 node134 双数据库主库
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_multi_database_physical_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_multi_database_physical_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_multi_database_physical_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres,test'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 18
max_logical_replication_workers = 12
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 12
max_wal_senders = 12
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15577
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_multi_database_physical_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_multi_database_physical_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_multi_database_physical_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start

steps.title: 在 node134 的两个数据库创建节点和组

cases.name: all 模式在线业务 join 数据一致性
prerequisites: 复用文档在线 join 用例的 31 表结构、63 字节长表/列和业务 SQL；每表存量缩小为 3 行。
join 期间源端持续执行 20 次 INSERT/UPDATE，包含 test1 超 8KB 字段、test4/test24 更新和长表插入。

steps.title: 初始化在线业务源节点 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_online_join_all_{run_id}/source; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_online_join_all_{run_id}/source -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_online_join_all_{run_id}/source/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15524
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_online_join_all_{run_id}/source/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_online_join_all_{run_id}/source -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_online_join_all_{run_id}/source/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_online_join_all_{run_id}/source/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15524 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15524 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_default_global_repset_{run_id}/source; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_default_global_repset_{run_id}/source -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_default_global_repset_{run_id}/source/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15671
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_default_global_repset_{run_id}/source/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_default_global_repset_{run_id}/source -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_default_global_repset_{run_id}/source/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_default_global_repset_{run_id}/source/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15671 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15671 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'

port = 15651

steps.title: 按 mmr-autotest 时序执行 node135 UPDATE 与 node134 DELETE
argv: update_log={env.tmp_root}_stream_recent_update_49001.log; rm -f "$update_log"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; UPDATE immediate_parallel_conflict SET name=repeat('b',128) WHERE id BETWEEN 49001 AND 49512; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(370049001); SELECT pg_sleep(3); COMMIT" >"$update_log" 2>&1 & update_pid=$!; ready=; for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do if ! kill -0 "$update_pid" 2>/dev/null; then cat "$update_log"; wait "$update_pid"; exit 1; fi; ready=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(370049001)' 2>/dev/null || true); test "$ready" = f && break; sleep 0.1; done; test "$ready" = f || { echo 'node135 UPDATE transaction was not ready'; kill "$update_pid"; wait "$update_pid" || true; exit 1; }; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'DELETE FROM immediate_parallel_conflict WHERE id BETWEEN 49001 AND 49512'; sleep 1; update_status=0; wait "$update_pid" || update_status=$?; cat "$update_log"; rm -f "$update_log"; exit "$update_status"

steps.title: 初始化 node134

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15493
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_multi_unique_{run_id}/source/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15493 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15493 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: 两端 MMR streaming=parallel；node134 two_phase=false，node135 two_phase=true。
node134 缺少 city，node135 的 city 有默认值；node135 的 source_column_missing=use_default_value。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
cases.teardown: fixture 以 immediate 停止临时 node134/node135 并删除目录；临时复制集、订阅、复制槽和冲突记录一并清除。

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node135; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node135 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node135/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15652
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node135/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node135 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node135/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node135/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

cases.purpose: 验证2PC streaming delete_missing 的 skip 策略。重点核对：等待 node135 收到 512 行； rollback 后 node134 保留 513 行、node135 保留 512 行且无历史； commit 后 node135 删除 512 行并记录一条 skip 历史。
cases.final_state: 确认 commit 后 node135 删除 512 行并记录一条 skip 历史：45 秒内返回 0|1

cases.name: 2PC streaming delete_missing 的 skip_transaction 策略
cases.document: 多活streaming冲突处理测试文档.md

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: node135 的 delete_missing=skip_transaction；先按 3.1.2 重建 error 回放前态。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
cases.teardown: fixture 以 immediate 停止临时 node134/node135 并删除目录；临时复制集、订阅、复制槽和冲突记录一并清除。

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: node135 的 delete_recently_updated=error；node134 删除与 node135 更新同一批 512 行。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
cases.teardown: fixture 以 immediate 停止临时 node134/node135 并删除目录；临时复制集、订阅、复制槽和冲突记录一并清除。

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'

port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。

prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。

argv: work={env.tmp_root}_mixed_insert_exists; rm -rf "$work"; mkdir -p "$work"; status=0; for i in 1 5 9; do {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; INSERT INTO immediate_parallel_insert_exists_mixed VALUES($i, 'prepared-' || $i); PREPARE TRANSACTION 'mixed_2pc_$i';" >"$work/prepared_$i.log" 2>&1 & done; for i in 2 6 10; do {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; INSERT INTO immediate_parallel_insert_exists_mixed VALUES($i, 'rollback-' || $i); SELECT pg_sleep(3); ROLLBACK;" >"$work/rollback_$i.log" 2>&1 & done; for i in 3 7 11; do {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; INSERT INTO immediate_parallel_insert_exists_mixed VALUES($i, 'plain-' || $i); SELECT pg_sleep(3); COMMIT;" >"$work/plain_$i.log" 2>&1 & done; for i in 1000 1001 1002; do {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "INSERT INTO immediate_parallel_insert_exists_mixed VALUES($i, 'normal-' || $i);" >"$work/normal_$i.log" 2>&1 || status=1; done; for pid in $(jobs -p); do wait "$pid" || status=1; done; for i in 1 5 9; do {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "COMMIT PREPARED 'mixed_2pc_$i';" >>"$work/prepared_$i.log" 2>&1 || status=1; done; cat "$work"/*.log; rm -rf "$work"; exit "$status"

steps.title: 确认六个已提交冲突均写入历史、三条回滚不回放、三条正常数据同步
argv: last=''; last_status=0; for i in $(seq 1 45); do v=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM immediate_parallel_insert_exists_mixed WHERE id IN (1,3,5,7,9,11) AND name='a')::text || '|' || (SELECT count(*) FROM immediate_parallel_insert_exists_mixed WHERE id BETWEEN 1000 AND 1002 AND name='normal-' || id::text)::text || '|' || (SELECT count(*) FROM fdd.mmr_conflict_history WHERE relname='immediate_parallel_insert_exists_mixed' AND conflict_type='insert_exists' AND conflict_resolution='skip')::text" 2>&1); last_status=$?; last=$v; test "$last_status" = 0 && test "$v" = '6|3|6' && { echo "$v"; exit 0; }; sleep 1; done; printf '最后一次 psql 退出码=%s，输出=%s\n' "$last_status" "$last"; exit 1

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。

prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

cases.purpose: 验证2PC streaming source_column_missing 的 skip 策略。重点核对：两端 MMR streaming 和 two_phase； rollback 后无目标行且无冲突历史； commit 后写入 512 行并记录 512 条历史。
cases.final_state: 确认 commit 后写入 512 行并记录 512 条历史：45 秒内返回 0|512

cases.name: 2PC streaming source_column_missing 的 use_default_value 策略
cases.document: 多活streaming冲突处理测试文档.md

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: node134 表缺 city 列，node135 含默认 city；node135 的 source_column_missing=use_default_value。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
cases.teardown: fixture 以 immediate 停止临时 node134/node135 并删除目录；临时复制集、订阅、复制槽和冲突记录一并清除。

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: node135 的 update_missing=skip；分别验证 rollback prepared 与 commit prepared。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
cases.teardown: fixture 以 immediate 停止临时 node134/node135 并删除目录；临时复制集、订阅、复制槽和冲突记录一并清除。

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

argv: {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET debug_logical_replication_streaming='immediate'"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET logical_decoding_work_mem='64kB'"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_reload_conf()'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134

wal_level = logical

cases.purpose: 验证2PC streaming update_pkey_exists 的 error 策略。重点核对：等待 node135 收到 512 行主键更新前置数据； rollback 后 node135 保留旧主键、无新主键且历史为 0； commit 后 node135 新主键为 512 行且历史为 1。
cases.final_state: 确认 commit 后 node135 新主键为 512 行且历史为 1：45 秒内返回 0|512|1

cases.name: 2PC streaming update_pkey_exists 的 skip 策略

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: node135 的 update_pkey_exists=skip；两个节点并发更新同一批 512 个主键。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
cases.teardown: fixture 以 immediate 停止临时 node134/node135 并删除目录；临时复制集、订阅、复制槽和冲突记录一并清除。

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8

cases.purpose: 验证2PC streaming update_pkey_exists 的 update 策略。重点核对：等待 node135 收到 512 行主键更新前置数据； rollback 后 node135 保留旧主键、无新主键且历史为 0； commit 后 node135 新主键为 512 行且历史为 512。
cases.final_state: 确认 commit 后 node135 新主键为 512 行且历史为 512：45 秒内返回 0|512|512

cases.name: 2PC streaming update_pkey_exists 的 update_if_newer 策略
cases.document: 多活streaming冲突处理测试文档.md

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: node135 的 update_pkey_exists=update_if_newer；两个节点并发更新同一批 512 个主键。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
cases.teardown: fixture 以 immediate 停止临时 node134/node135 并删除目录；临时复制集、订阅、复制槽和冲突记录一并清除。

cases.purpose: 验证2PC streaming update_pkey_exists 的 update_if_newer 策略。重点核对：等待 node135 收到 512 行主键更新前置数据； rollback 后 node135 保留旧主键、无新主键且无冲突历史； commit 后 node135 新主键为 512 行并记录 512 条冲突。
cases.final_state: 确认 commit 后 node135 新主键为 512 行并记录 512 条冲突：45 秒内返回 0|512|512

cases.name: 2PC streaming update_recently_deleted 的 error 策略

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: node135 的 update_recently_deleted=error；node135 删除与 node134 更新同一批 512 行。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
cases.teardown: fixture 以 immediate 停止临时 node134/node135 并删除目录；临时复制集、订阅、复制槽和冲突记录一并清除。

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

argv: target_log={env.tmp_root}_recent_delete_stream_59_rollback_59001.log; rm -f "$target_log"; ({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; DELETE FROM immediate_parallel_2pc WHERE id BETWEEN 59001 AND 59512; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(310059001); SELECT pg_sleep(4); PREPARE TRANSACTION 'stream_59'" >"$target_log" 2>&1 && {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "ROLLBACK PREPARED 'stream_59'" >>"$target_log" 2>&1) & target_pid=$!; ready=; for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do if ! kill -0 "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null; then cat "$target_log"; wait "$target_pid"; exit 1; fi; ready=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(310059001)' 2>/dev/null || true); test "$ready" = f && break; sleep 0.1; done; test "$ready" = f || { echo 'node135 DELETE transaction was not ready'; kill "$target_pid"; wait "$target_pid" || true; exit 1; }; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; UPDATE immediate_parallel_2pc SET name=repeat('b',128) WHERE id BETWEEN 59001 AND 59512; PREPARE TRANSACTION 'stream_59';"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "ROLLBACK PREPARED 'stream_59'"; sleep 1; target_status=0; wait "$target_pid" || target_status=$?; cat "$target_log"; rm -f "$target_log"; exit "$target_status"

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:

shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'

argv: target_log={env.tmp_root}_recent_delete_stream_60_rollback_60001.log; rm -f "$target_log"; ({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; DELETE FROM immediate_parallel_2pc WHERE id BETWEEN 60001 AND 60512; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(310060001); SELECT pg_sleep(4); PREPARE TRANSACTION 'stream_60'" >"$target_log" 2>&1 && {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "ROLLBACK PREPARED 'stream_60'" >>"$target_log" 2>&1) & target_pid=$!; ready=; for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do if ! kill -0 "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null; then cat "$target_log"; wait "$target_pid"; exit 1; fi; ready=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(310060001)' 2>/dev/null || true); test "$ready" = f && break; sleep 0.1; done; test "$ready" = f || { echo 'node135 DELETE transaction was not ready'; kill "$target_pid"; wait "$target_pid" || true; exit 1; }; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; UPDATE immediate_parallel_2pc SET name=repeat('b',128) WHERE id BETWEEN 60001 AND 60512; PREPARE TRANSACTION 'stream_60';"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "ROLLBACK PREPARED 'stream_60'"; sleep 1; target_status=0; wait "$target_pid" || target_status=$?; cat "$target_log"; rm -f "$target_log"; exit "$target_status"

argv: target_log={env.tmp_root}_recent_delete_stream_56_rollback_56001.log; rm -f "$target_log"; ({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; DELETE FROM immediate_parallel_2pc WHERE id BETWEEN 56001 AND 56512; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(310056001); SELECT pg_sleep(4); PREPARE TRANSACTION 'stream_56'" >"$target_log" 2>&1 && {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "ROLLBACK PREPARED 'stream_56'" >>"$target_log" 2>&1) & target_pid=$!; ready=; for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do if ! kill -0 "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null; then cat "$target_log"; wait "$target_pid"; exit 1; fi; ready=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(310056001)' 2>/dev/null || true); test "$ready" = f && break; sleep 0.1; done; test "$ready" = f || { echo 'node135 DELETE transaction was not ready'; kill "$target_pid"; wait "$target_pid" || true; exit 1; }; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; UPDATE immediate_parallel_2pc SET name=repeat('b',128) WHERE id BETWEEN 56001 AND 56512; PREPARE TRANSACTION 'stream_56';"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "ROLLBACK PREPARED 'stream_56'"; sleep 1; target_status=0; wait "$target_pid" || target_status=$?; cat "$target_log"; rm -f "$target_log"; exit "$target_status"

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15498
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15498 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15498 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功
