steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15498
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15498 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15498 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15498
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_conflict_origin_{run_id}/source/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15498 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15498 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

steps.title: 初始化 node134
argv:
mkdir -p {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134; {env.db_bin_dir}/initdb -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -U {env.user} --auth-local=trust --auth-host=trust; cp {env.license_file} {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/license.dat; printf "
shared_preload_libraries = 'fdd_mmr'
fdd.running_databases = 'postgres'
wal_level = logical
track_commit_timestamp = on
max_worker_processes = 16
max_logical_replication_workers = 8
max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_sync_workers_per_subscription = 2
max_replication_slots = 10
max_wal_senders = 12
debug_logical_replication_streaming = 'buffered'
logical_decoding_work_mem = '64MB'
listen_addresses = '{env.local_host}'
port = 15651
" >> {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/postgresql.conf; for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do {env.db_bin_dir}/pg_ctl -D {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134 -l {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log -w start && break; if grep -q 'Address already in use' {env.tmp_root}_mmr_stream_delete_missing_{run_id}/node134/start.log && test "$attempt" -lt 20; then sleep 0.5; else exit 1; fi; done; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fdd_mmr'; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'CREATE EXTENSION fb_license'
steps.expected: 初始化、启动并创建两个扩展成功

steps.title: 按 mmr-autotest 时序执行 node135 DELETE 与 node134 UPDATE
argv: work={env.tmp_root}_stream_recent_delete_58001; fifo="$work.stdin"; delete_log="$work.delete.log"; update_log="$work.update.log"; rm -f "$fifo" "$delete_log" "$update_log"; mkfifo "$fifo"; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -f "$fifo" >"$delete_log" 2>&1 & delete_pid=$!; exec 3>"$fifo"; printf '%s\n' 'BEGIN; DELETE FROM immediate_parallel_conflict WHERE id BETWEEN 58001 AND 58512; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(390058001);' >&3; ready=; for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do if ! kill -0 "$delete_pid" 2>/dev/null; then cat "$delete_log"; wait "$delete_pid"; exit 1; fi; ready=$({env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -At -h {env.local_host} -p 15652 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(390058001)' 2>/dev/null || true); test "$ready" = f && break; sleep 0.1; done; test "$ready" = f || { echo 'node135 DELETE transaction was not ready'; exec 3>&-; kill "$delete_pid"; wait "$delete_pid" || true; exit 1; }; {env.db_bin_dir}/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -P pager=off -h {env.local_host} -p 15651 -U {env.user} -d postgres -c "BEGIN; SELECT pg_sleep(1); UPDATE immediate_parallel_conflict SET name=repeat('b',128) WHERE id BETWEEN 58001 AND 58512; SELECT pg_sleep(6); COMMIT;" >"$update_log" 2>&1; update_status=$?; printf 'COMMIT;\n' >&3; exec 3>&-; delete_status=0; wait "$delete_pid" || delete_status=$?; cat "$update_log" "$delete_log"; rm -f "$fifo" "$delete_log" "$update_log"; test "$update_status" = 0 && test "$delete_status" = 0

test_topology.summary: 节点数=2；node134/node135 为对等可写 MMR 主节点；无物理备库、无独立普通逻辑复制。
relations: MMR 多活: node134 <-> node135（双向复制）

conflict_configuration: 两端 MMR streaming=parallel；node134 two_phase=false，node135 two_phase=true。
本节 resolver：node135 的 update_recently_deleted=skip；node135 DELETE 保持未提交，node134 UPDATE 完成后再提交 DELETE。
prerequisites: 严格按文档使用临时 two_phase 双节点，不触碰共享 mmr。
512 行、每行 128 字节的 INSERT 超过 64kB，触发 streaming 大事务路径。
